Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against target CHEMBL1824. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, and activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, then molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno for canonical SMILES. Filter: target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', tax_id = 9606, standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not deduplicate. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows.
